CORRECTION_zero_artifact.note: the apparent 51% link was an ARTIFACT: the typeinfo u32[11] domain contains 0, and 305620 of the 597760 fieldinf u32 values are 0.  The match count therefore equals the zero count almost exactly.
CORRECTION_zero_artifact.verdict: 117 nonzero matches vs 2.5 expected at random - the only recurring value is the 0xFFFFFFFF sentinel (117x).  CONCLUSION: there is NO key-based typeinfo<->fieldinf link; the two tables are independent.

structure.element_size: 0x08 window {u32 payload, u32 tag} - at every tested stride the odd u32 slot has only 8-10 distinct values, i.e. it is a tag/flag set, and the even slot carries the payload
structure.payload_slot_content: the payload slot mixes three kinds of data: (a) small integers that are member OFFSETS (multiples of 8 plus bitfield widths 1/2/3/4), (b) low 32 bits of .data VAs (0x49FB5xxx) that address the .data type cells, (c) 32-bit keys. The section is a serialised, variable-length record stream, not a flat array of one fixed record type.
structure.dominant_stride_inside_runs: 0x30 (151 runs in typeinfo / equivalent grouping in fieldinf)

payload_cell_format.note: the most frequent fieldinf payload values (0x49FB5B88, 0x49FB5BE8, 0x49FB5C28 ...) are the low 32 bits of VAs into .data; the .data cell they point to is 0x20 bytes: {u64 node-VA into typeinfo section, u16 flags=0xFFFF, u16 type_size, u32 0xFFFFFFFF, zeros}

no_strings: the fieldinf section contains no .rdata string pointers (1 qword total in the whole section)

member_names.resolved_strings_are: false positives (' types' x11, 'AndSizeCombo' x4, 'GameReportFilter' x2, ...)
member_names.verdict: the fieldinf section carries NO member names; only 32-bit keys

type_linkage.why: the anchor set only covers the records reached by the 5000 decoded registration stubs; the other ~24000 records are not name-linked on disk
type_linkage.chain: fieldinf payload -> .data 0x20 cell (VA low 32 bits) -> cell.q0 -> static typeinfo record -> (name via code, not via the key)

offset_availability.where: payload slot of the 8-byte {u32 payload, u32 tag} elements
offset_availability.note: offsets are recoverable statically per type; the NAMES are not
